options: The tariff on a car imported from India to Pakistan is less than 120 percent of the price of a car in Pakistan.
It takes 120 percent less time to transport a car in India than it does in Pakistan.
Importing cars from India to Pakistan will eliminate 120 percent of the sales of cars in Pakistan.
Petrol prices in India are 120 percent below those in Pakistan.
appearance.subject: gk
appearance.canonical_answer_text: The tariff on a car imported from India to Pakistan is less than 120 percent of the price of a car in Pakistan.
